scope: Owner-requested replacement of the Racer career's RACE engine with the Reef Grand Prix. It is an original true-2D perspective kart race on the Pearl Canal Circuit, the Racer's own in-game canal painting laid out flat. It has the owner's touch layout (green stick on the left; red brake and an item/boost bubble on the right), pearls that raise top speed and are never lost, original items from gem buoys and arch bubbles, a lane-holding steering assist, and the DL-INT-14 imp contest (only the race restarts; he slows after wins; ties go to Roshan). Claude wrote the engine at the owner's explicit request and a written Codex art handoff whose requests only reorganize existing assets (owner rule 2026-11-03). It benefits the child with a real race she steers with one finger, plain controls, no fail state and no progress loss. Nothing from the commercial game the owner had running was copied. It is not merged during the demo freeze.
finding_scope: MA-OPERA-014 gains three owner decisions and a 2026-11-03 history entry. Its Racer fix and tests now point at this engine. Lifecycle is unchanged (IN_PROGRESS): the engine is an unmerged work-branch candidate, and visual, device, child and owner acceptance are open.
